glossary.definition: (A) "State, states, or States" means one or several of the fifty states of the United States, Puerto Rico, the Virgin Islands, and the District of Columbia.
glossary.source_title: Section 5149.18 - Interstate compact for supervision of parolees and probationers definitions.

glossary.definition: (B) The term "parole" includes post-release control under section 2967.28 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 5149.18 - Interstate compact for supervision of parolees and probationers definitions.

glossary.definition: (C) The term "probation" includes non-prison sanctions imposed under sections 2929.16 , 2929.17 , and 2929.18 of the Revised Code and community control sanctions imposed under sections 2929.26 , 2929.27 , and 2929.28 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 5149.18 - Interstate compact for supervision of parolees and probationers definitions.
